# Persona Generator

> Unreleased psychology-grounded desired-trait specification, explicit agent/subagent binding and persistent local revision layer. Engineering hypotheses are not human psychometric validity or proven model stability.

Ask for desired agent behavior, not owner personality. Unspecified stays unspecified. Confirm complete previews genuinely; synthetic fixtures are not consent. Revisions and agent bindings are explicit; no inheritance, averaging, automatic latest-version upgrade or permission transfer. Task overrides do not rewrite saved profiles. No live behavioral experiments in this increment. Existing evidence does not transfer to new hypotheses. No website or automatic release.
